invariants: A tenant can reserve only its own inventory and stock never becomes negative.
Concurrent last-unit reservations produce one success and one conflict.
An idempotency key is scoped to tenant and operation payload and retries have no duplicate effects.
Inventory persistence and outbox publication commit together or leave no externally visible change.
Checkout is repeatable and cannot charge an order that was not reserved.
rationale: The task requires coordinating per-tenant inventory, asynchronous concurrency, idempotency, persistence rollback, and an outbox across separate modules.
